text.p: Basic Petroleum International Ltd said Thursday it has completed Xan-13, a development well in the northern part of the company's Xan field in Guatemala.
The company also said the Guatemalan Government has approved the transfer of Contract 5-93 to Basic Petroleum from its present owners. The contract consists of two areas totaling 629,000 acres.
Basic said the new Xan well tested at some 2,300 barrels per day, bringing Basic's daily production to about 21,000 barrels.

The company said this is the eleventh successful well drilled in the Xan field, four of which were completed in 1996. "We will continue to increase our production from this valuable field from the eleven wells already in production and the added production from at least four additional development wells which are expected to be drilled in 1997."
